## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.

The running status should preserve the 12-character revision identifier promised by its docstring and used by history. This review read both changed files and all existing tests; no tests were run.

## Changes
The pull request adds running deployment status output with a revision prefix and attempt number, plus tests for attempt formatting.

## Important
- app/display.py:14 — correctness — Preserve the 12-character revision in status — For revision `0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567`, `status(revision, 2)` displays `0123456`, while `history(revision)` displays `0123456789ab`. Your status docstring promises “the same identifier as history,” but this slice takes seven characters and history takes twelve at `app/display.py:5`. — Users receive inconsistent revision identifiers across deployment views, and revisions sharing seven leading characters become indistinguishable in running status.
